scripts.clean: find . -name node_modules -type d -prune -exec rm -rf '{}' + && find . -maxdepth 1 -type f \( -name '*.js' -o -name '*.log' -o -name '*.txt' \) -not -name 'eslint.config.js' -delete && rm -rf .eslintcache tsconfig.eslint.tsbuildinfo reports tmp node_debug.log eslint-suppressions.json test/dist && pnpm -r run clean:types && pnpm run clean:src-js && pnpm store prune
scripts.doctor:pnpm-install: bash -lc 'echo "== tool versions =="; node -v; pnpm -v; npm -v; echo; echo "== registry config =="; pnpm config get registry; npm config get registry; echo; echo "== proxy config (before) =="; pnpm config get proxy; pnpm config get https-proxy; npm config get proxy; npm config get https-proxy; echo; echo "== proxy environment =="; env | grep -iE "^(http|https|all)_proxy=" || echo "(none)"; stale_proxy="http://proxy:8080"; if [ "$(pnpm config get proxy)" = "$stale_proxy" ] || [ "$(pnpm config get https-proxy)" = "$stale_proxy" ] || [ "$(npm config get proxy)" = "$stale_proxy" ] || [ "$(npm config get https-proxy)" = "$stale_proxy" ]; then echo; echo "Detected stale proxy config ($stale_proxy). Clearing npm/pnpm proxy settings..."; pnpm config delete proxy || true; pnpm config delete https-proxy || true; npm config delete proxy || true; npm config delete https-proxy || true; else echo; echo "No stale proxy config detected; no proxy changes applied."; fi; echo; echo "== proxy config (after) =="; pnpm config get proxy; pnpm config get https-proxy; npm config get proxy; npm config get https-proxy; echo; echo "== npm registry ping =="; npm ping --registry https://registry.npmjs.org || true; echo; echo "== pnpm registry metadata fetch =="; pnpm view pnpm version --registry https://registry.npmjs.org --silent || true'
scripts.build: pnpm run build:ts && pnpm run build:gml-identifiers:compiled && pnpm run build:feather-metadata:compiled
scripts.build:gml-identifiers: pnpm run ensure:cli && pnpm run build:gml-identifiers:compiled
scripts.build:feather-metadata: pnpm run ensure:cli && pnpm run build:feather-metadata:compiled
scripts.rebuild: pnpm run clean:ts && pnpm run build
scripts.rebuild:ts: pnpm run clean:ts && pnpm run build:ts
scripts.lint:ci: eslint . --max-warnings=0 --report-unused-disable-directives && pnpm run lint:workflows && pnpm run lint:yaml
scripts.format:gml: pnpm run ensure:cli && pnpm run cli:compiled -- format
scripts.test: pnpm run build:ts && pnpm run test:compiled && pnpm run test:fixtures:compiled
scripts.test:fixtures: pnpm run build:ts && bash -lc 'test_file="test/dist/fixture-suites.js"; if [ ! -f "$test_file" ]; then echo "Compiled fixture test runner not found: $test_file" >&2; exit 1; fi; node --test-force-exit --test --test-timeout=120000 "$test_file"'
scripts.test:ensure-junit:
node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const p='reports/tests.xml'; const status=process.env.TEST_STATUS ?? 'unknown'; const xml=fs.existsSync(p)?fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8').trim():''; const ok=xml.startsWith('<?xml')&&xml.includes('<testsuites')&&xml.includes('</testsuites>'); if(!ok){const m='Test runner exited with status '+status+' before producing a valid JUnit report.'; const e=m.replace(/&/g,'&').replace(/</g,'<').replace(/>/g,'>').replace(/"/g,'"').replace(/'/g,'''); const fallback='<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
' + '<testsuites>
' + '  <testsuite name="test-runner" tests="1" failures="1" errors="0" skipped="0">
' + '    <testcase name="test-runner"><failure message="' + e + '">' + e + '</failure></testcase>
' + '  </testsuite>
' + '</testsuites>
'; fs.writeFileSync(p,fallback,'utf8'); }"
scripts.test:compiled: bash -lc 'mapfile -t tests < <(pnpm -s test:list); ((${#tests[@]})) || { echo "No compiled test files found under dist/ or test/" >&2; exit 1; }; node --test-force-exit --test --test-timeout=120000 "${tests[@]}"'
scripts.test:quiet: pnpm run build:ts && bash -lc 'set -o pipefail; mapfile -t tests < <(pnpm -s test:list); ((${#tests[@]})) || { echo "No compiled test files found under dist/ or test/" >&2; exit 1; }; node --test-force-exit --test --test-timeout=120000 --test-reporter=tap "${tests[@]}" 2>/dev/null | grep -E "^# (tests|suites|pass|fail|cancelled|skipped|todo|duration_ms)"'
scripts.test:report: pnpm run build:ts && pnpm run test:report:compiled
scripts.test:report:compiled: bash -lc 'mkdir -p reports; rm -f reports/lcov.info reports/tests.xml; mapfile -t tests < <(pnpm -s test:list); if ((${#tests[@]})); then ./node_modules/.bin/c8 --reporter=lcovonly --report-dir=reports node --test-force-exit --test --test-timeout=120000 --test-reporter=dot --test-reporter-destination=stdout --test-reporter=junit --test-reporter-destination=reports/tests.xml "${tests[@]}"; status=$?; else echo "No compiled test files found under dist/ or test/" >&2; status=1; fi; TEST_STATUS=$status pnpm -s test:ensure-junit; rm -rf .nyc_output reports/tmp reports/lcov-report; exit $status'
scripts.test:core:report: pnpm --filter @gmloop/core... run build:types && mkdir -p reports && node --test-force-exit --test --test-timeout=120000 --test-reporter=junit --test-reporter-destination=./reports/core.xml src/core/dist/test/*.test.js
scripts.test:parser:report: pnpm --filter @gmloop/parser... run build:types && mkdir -p reports && node --test-force-exit --test --test-timeout=120000 --test-reporter=junit --test-reporter-destination=./reports/parser.xml src/parser/dist/test/*.test.js
scripts.test:refactor:report: pnpm --filter @gmloop/refactor... run build:types && mkdir -p reports && node --test-force-exit --test --test-timeout=120000 --test-reporter=junit --test-reporter-destination=./reports/refactor.xml src/refactor/dist/test/*.test.js
scripts.test:semantic:report: pnpm --filter @gmloop/semantic... run build:types && mkdir -p reports && node --test-force-exit --test --test-timeout=120000 --test-reporter=junit --test-reporter-destination=./reports/semantic.xml src/semantic/dist/test/*.test.js
scripts.test:runtime-wrapper:report: pnpm --filter @gmloop/runtime-wrapper... run build:types && mkdir -p reports && node --test-force-exit --test --test-timeout=120000 --test-reporter=junit --test-reporter-destination=./reports/runtime-wrapper.xml src/runtime-wrapper/dist/test/*.test.js
scripts.test:transpiler:report: pnpm --filter @gmloop/transpiler... run build:types && mkdir -p reports && node --test-force-exit --test --test-timeout=120000 --test-reporter=junit --test-reporter-destination=./reports/transpiler.xml src/transpiler/dist/test/*.test.js
scripts.test:format: pnpm --filter @gmloop/format... run build:types && pnpm run test:format:compiled
scripts.test:format:compiled: bash -lc 'mapfile -t tests < <(pnpm -s test:format:files); ((${#tests[@]})) || { echo "No compiled format test files found" >&2; exit 1; }; node --test --test-timeout=120000 "${tests[@]}"'
scripts.test:format:report: pnpm --filter @gmloop/format... run build:types && pnpm run test:format:report:compiled
scripts.test:format:report:compiled: bash -lc 'mkdir -p reports; rm -f reports/format.xml; mapfile -t tests < <(pnpm -s test:format:files); ((${#tests[@]})) || { echo "No compiled format test files found" >&2; exit 1; }; node --test-force-exit --test --test-timeout=120000 --test-reporter=junit --test-reporter-destination=./reports/format.xml "${tests[@]}"'
scripts.test:cli:report: pnpm run ensure:cli && mkdir -p reports && node --test-force-exit --test --test-timeout=120000 --test-reporter=junit --test-reporter-destination=./reports/cli.xml src/cli/dist/test/*.test.js
scripts.test:root:report: pnpm run build:ts && mkdir -p reports && node --test-force-exit --test --test-timeout=120000 --test-reporter=junit --test-reporter-destination=./reports/root.xml test/dist/*.test.js
scripts.test:performance: pnpm run build:ts && bash -lc 'mkdir -p reports; mapfile -t tests < <(find src test -type f \( -path '\''*/dist/test/*performance*.test.js'\'' -o -path '\''*/dist/test/*perf*.test.js'\'' -o -path '\''*/dist/test/performance/*.test.js'\'' \) -not -path '\''*/node_modules/*'\''); tests+=(test/dist/fixture-profile-report.js); GMLOOP_FIXTURE_PROFILE=1 node --test-force-exit --test --test-timeout=120000 --test-reporter=spec --test-reporter-destination=stdout --test-reporter=junit --test-reporter-destination=reports/performance.xml --test-concurrency=1 "${tests[@]}"'
scripts.test:fixtures:profile:deep-cpu: pnpm run build:ts && GMLOOP_FIXTURE_PROFILE=1 GMLOOP_FIXTURE_DEEP_CPU=1 node --test-force-exit --test --test-timeout=120000 test/dist/fixture-profile-report.perf.js
scripts.report: bash -lc 'status=0; mkdir -p reports; pnpm run build:ts || status=$?; pnpm run lint:report || status=$?; if [ "${GITHUB_WORKFLOW:-}" != "Auto-merge PRs" ]; then pnpm run lint:duplicates:report || status=$?; fi; pnpm run test:report:compiled || status=$?; pnpm run stats:report:compiled || status=$?; if [ "${GITHUB_WORKFLOW:-}" != "Auto-merge PRs" ]; then pnpm run tree:report || status=$?; fi; pnpm run quality:report:compiled || status=$?; exit $status'
scripts.stats:report: pnpm run ensure:cli && pnpm run stats:report:compiled
scripts.quality:report: pnpm run ensure:cli && pnpm run quality:report:compiled
scripts.cli: pnpm run ensure:cli && pnpm run cli:compiled
scripts.link:global: bash -lc 'pnpm run ensure:cli && entry="$PWD/src/cli/dist/index.js" && pnpm_bin_output="$(pnpm bin -g 2>/dev/null || true)" && global_bin="$(printf "%s\n" "$pnpm_bin_output" | grep "^/" | tail -n 1)" && if [ -z "$global_bin" ]; then global_bin="${PNPM_HOME:-$HOME/Library/pnpm}/bin"; fi && mkdir -p "$global_bin" && chmod +x "$entry" && ln -sf "$entry" "$global_bin/gmloop" && echo "Linked gmloop -> $entry"'
scripts.postinstall: pnpm run submodules && patch-package && pnpm run link:global || true
scripts.commit: bash -lc 'msg=${BUMP_COMMIT_MESSAGE:-${npm_config_commit_message:-"chore: formatting"}}; if [ $# -gt 0 ]; then msg="$*"; fi; if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ]; then if [ -z "${SKIP_FORMAT:-}" ]; then pnpm run format:quiet; fi && (pnpm run lint:fix || true) && git add . && git commit --no-verify -m "$msg"; fi && git pull --rebase && git push' --
scripts.submodules: chmod -R u+w vendor && git submodule foreach --recursive 'git reset --hard && git clean -fd' && git submodule sync --recursive && git submodule update --init --recursive --remote && chmod -R a-w vendor && chmod -R a+X vendor && chmod -R u+w vendor/3DSpider && git ls-files vendor | xargs git update-index --skip-worktree
scripts.demo:run: bash -lc 'pnpm run ensure:cli && chmod -R u+w vendor/3DSpider && (cd vendor/3DSpider && git reset --hard && git clean -fd) && git submodule update --init --recursive --remote vendor/3DSpider && pnpm run cli:compiled -- "$@" && mkdir -p reports && (cd vendor/3DSpider && git diff > ../../reports/3DSpider.diff)' --
scripts.demo:watch: pnpm --filter @gmloop/runtime-wrapper... run build:types && pnpm run ensure:cli && node ./src/cli/dist/index.js prepare-hot-reload && node ./src/cli/dist/index.js watch vendor/3DSpider --verbose --no-runtime-server
